6886978.name: Cat simulator 1.0.2 [BUGS FIXED]
6886978.author: Balt Tlab
6886978.description: Warning! this game isnt for people who randomly jumps around the map,doesnt read texts, instruction and yell "how to play111" HOW TO PLAY: This game is basically cat taming and feed kittens Cats: 1. There are 14+ different types of cats and rarer they are, less chance of you taming them 2. They spawn inside the cement wall 3. But not all of them will enter because your bait (fish,fruit,perfume) is not attractive enough 4. First most common cats will enter and if you tame them with a TOOL, 25% chance of they will give you a kitten (Ill explain later) and 75% chance of giving you FL (Friendship level) 5. You can use FL to unlock better baits for the rare cats to enter the cement wall 6. Common cats gives you low FL but rare cats gives you high FL 7. You could also view the cats you tamed on COLLECTION (Ill explain it later) Kittens: 1. They will only be in your house once a cat gave them to you 2. Cats only gives kittens on their own type but only ONCE 3. You can give toy/music/food to the kittens but only if they need it and they pay you back with FL ;) 4. If you feed them enough they can grow to be adult cats 5. The grown kittens/cats will still stay in your house 6. Grown cats will automatically give you FL but they still beg for foods and stuff Tools: 1. There are 8 types of tools and they have levels on them 2. The highest level is 8 and it can tame EVERY single cats 3. Your starting tool is basic light and its lvl 1 taming only 1 cat type 4. You get better tools by doing a job in a pizza place 5. Your boss will award you a new tool if you do your job successfully Collection: 1. It views every cat you tamed and it shows their profile/give you a cat by pressing the pressure plates 2. It also shows you they're "Rarity", "FL" That's it folks, now enjoy the game Big thanks to: DjhasThaSwag, YT_LcLeviYT, 333_3,_ _ ᐛ Toothy ᐛ _ _ for supporting this game! I would also recommend you my other games (Poison Escape 2, Kogama checkpoint wars, DODGE THE BULLETS, Work at the pizza place) Old description: "bark" (literally)
